source_locator: R2247: C08030022600, 經過, 麾下及友軍ノ行動概要, 12 October 1942 (PDF p. 41, 一〇―一二). R2242: 11 October 1942
current_activity: in Joshima's seaplane-carrier force, landing troops at Tassafaronga (night of 11-12 Oct)
notes: JACAR 8th Fleet October 經過 (C08030022600, PDF p. 41) lists 日進、千歳、秋月、夏雲 landing artillery and 675 army troops on 12 October (一〇―一二). Cressman, 11 October 1942, has Rear Admiral Joshima's transport force, formed around seaplane carriers Chitose and Nisshin and six destroyers, reaching Tassafaronga to disembark elements of the 2nd Infantry Division. The claim is dated 12 October from the JACAR landing table, with Cressman's 11 October arrival treated as the night of 11–12. Confidence 0.7: JACAR (jacar) and Cressman (us_navy_nhhc) agree on the unit and the Tassafaronga landing in that night. Akizuki is named only in JACAR and is not entered.
